name: John Deere Horicon Works - Horicon WI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Old-style urban factory campus straddling the public street grid (W Lake St, N Vine St, E Walnut St run THROUGH the campus). No barrier arm or gate observed at any public-road / property-line interface in 2024-2025 Street View. Truck access into the north trailer yard is via an internal private campus drive; classified false because no controlled checkpoint exists where the property meets the public road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any street-level entrance. One small ~1-vehicle structure seen on an internal campus road near E Walnut St may be a watchman post, but it does not control a property-line truck gate, so guardShack=false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all (precondition not met).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal campus drive from N Vine St up to the north trailer yard / dock area is several hundred metres long and can stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimate 25-50: complex has multiple loading faces (sawtooth-roof factory bays, north dock building, staged-product yard with apron). Resolution limited by old factory roofs; counted ~35.
fieldNotes.dropArea: North trailer yard shows trailers in rows plus extensive staged-product / outside-storage area; web sources cite ~1.2M sq ft of outside storage & trailer area. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multi-building campus with assembly buildings, a north dock/trailer yard, and the south cluster across Lake St - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: multiple large building clusters - main complex north of W Lake St plus a secondary cluster south of Lake St, joined by a John Deere-branded enclosed bridge over the street.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Horicon WI is a small town (~3,500 population); facility is small-town industrial on the Rock River - per rubric, choose Rural.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Internal campus drive is 2 lanes; no formal gate lanes - low confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box bounds the built campus on the river peninsula at ~105 acres; total Horicon Works site is cited at 214 acres including outside storage spread across the peninsula.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur into the property observed; the surrounding area has no rail line adjacent.
